#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long solve(long long n, long long m) {
    if (n > m) {
        return solve(m, n);
    }

    if (n == 1) {
        long long correction[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
        return n * m - correction[m % 6];
    }

    if (n == 2) {
        if (m == 2) {
            return n * m - 4;
        }
        if (m == 3 || m == 7) {
            return n * m - 2;
        }
        return n * m;
    }

    if (n == 3) {
        return n * m - (m & 1LL);
    }

    return n * m - ((n & 1LL) & (m & 1LL));
}

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << solve(n, m) << endl;
    return 0;
}
